description: Portable bounded replay of A QUERY10 source-aware trade-power queries, A wrong-source execution, B corrected-source rejected execution, E inbound pending, and F accepted third-country trade-power response. A is deliberately incomplete at the consumer; B proves the rejected outcome becomes complete when the effect source is UTR; E/F prove the inbound context and response projection with the same UTR-to-FRA term.
